name: Screen heading
summary: A product page header — a title/greeting or a breadcrumb trail on the left, action buttons on the right, responsive across desktop / tablet / phone.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-screen-heading> — the product page header. A TITLE AREA on the left is either a page title / greeting (Heading4 24/600, with an optional brand-accent `highlight` span for a name — "Welcome, **Brian**!") OR a `›`-arrow breadcrumb trail for a sub-page, rendered by the reused <aha-breadcrumb>. An ACTIONS AREA on the right is a slot the consumer fills with <aha-button>s. An optional `description` subtitle sits under the title. `device` gives a deterministic responsive layout for the docs / qa: desktop + tablet keep title-left / actions-right on one row, phone wraps the actions below. REUSE, not rewrite — the trail is <aha-breadcrumb>, the actions are slotted <aha-button>s; this element only lays the two areas out. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) renders it directly via attributes (breadcrumb is a JSON attribute); Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design; the breadcrumb trail and the action buttons are the DS's own <aha-breadcrumb> / <aha-button> primitives, never rewritten here.

whenToUse.when: the header row of a product page — a title/greeting or a hierarchy trail plus the page's primary actions
only the ancestor trail is needed, with no title-level heading or actions (use <aha-breadcrumb> directly)
a titled content container, not the page-level header

opinion.note: One primary action on the right at most; the rest secondary. Use a plain `title` for a top-level page (optionally with a `highlight` name), and a `breadcrumb` trail for a sub-page. Keep the title a short sentence-case phrase.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 Screen heading (fileKey P764iQ6y4ZwW7W3f7FLZyW, node 2237:55733; Desktop / Tablet / Phone device variants). The Desktop symbol = a Breadcrumb instance + a (hidden) description line + a Button Group. Bindings from get_variable_defs: title Heading4 24 / weight 600 / line-height 1.3 / #1A1A1A (text-default), brand-accent name #6A1EBB (color-primary), gaps 8 (GapM) and 16 (GapL), icon 16. REUSE: the title trail is the shipped <aha-breadcrumb>; the actions are slotted <aha-button>s from the DS button — no second breadcrumb, no hand-rolled button.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probes the greeting header with a highlighted name and proves it reuses <aha-breadcrumb> when a trail is set.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-screen-heading[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var t=r&&r.querySelector('.title');var hl=r&&r.querySelector('.hl');var d=r&&r.querySelector('.desc');var st=t?getComputedStyle(t):null;var sd=d?getComputedStyle(d):null;var bc=document.querySelector('aha-screen-heading[breadcrumb]');var bcr=bc&&bc.shadowRoot;return{titleColor:st?st.color:null,titleSize:st?st.fontSize:null,titleWeight:st?st.fontWeight:null,highlightColor:hl?getComputedStyle(hl).color:null,descColor:sd?sd.color:null,reusesBreadcrumb:!!(bcr&&bcr.querySelector('aha-breadcrumb'))};})()
